items.alt: Investors cling to a plunging red market line as an oil barrel and a dollar-shaped gust bear down on the trading floor.
An older woman with a feature phone cuts an unwanted data bundle loose beside a circular calendar and a new month-long path.
A smiling AI mask gives a thumbs-up while its shadow secretly works switches behind a curtain and a human pulls the pause cord.
Medicine cartons stop at a red tariff gate while Indian specialty-treatment vials pass through a narrow green entry lane.
